trigger: On the Peavine road: a man with burros (trader).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Three burros on the switchback, packs piled like hay bales. An old man walking beside them, talking to them.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Whoa, Maisie. Afternoon! Wendell Rourke, Virginia City. I trade. Stories and salt, mostly.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: I'll sell you a candle for a story. Real one. If it's good I'll throw in tea.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Hm. That's a good one. Sad, but good. Father stories always are. Here.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Ohh, that's a juicy one. Whiskey for you. Don't tell Maisie.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Out east? Fallon's organized. Good folks, armed folks. And Dixie Valley's got a fence nobody talks about.

nodes.speaker: trader_rourke
nodes.text: Something got loose out there, the sheepmen say. Took forty head in a night. No blood on the sage. Ha. Tall tales.
